entries.text: Add a nightly dependency audit job to tidewater-ci. Standing rule: never auto-merge dependency updates into `main`.
And to repeat the standing rule: never auto-merge dependency updates into `main`.
Added the `audit` job in `.ci/nightly.yml`: it runs `bun audit` at 03:00 UTC.
Added the `audit-report.json` artifact, a chat notification to `#ci-nightly`, and a 30-day expiry for the artifacts.
The nightly pipeline #2231 finished at 03:07 UTC.
The first `audit` run found 2 high-severity advisories in `tidewater-web`.
Problem: the `audit` job times out after 10 minutes on the runner `tw-runner-3`.
Somebody has to deal with the findings.
Moved the job to `tw-runner-5`. The `audit` job no longer times out and no longer runs on `tw-runner-3`: it finishes in 1 min 40 s.
